in_sanskrit.name: Kummari
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Demoness, Warrior Goddess
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kummari एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Kummari is the name of a demoness or a fierce warrior goddess. She is often depicted as riding a tiger or a buffalo and wielding a sword or a trident. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kumari' meaning virgin or princess. Kummari is worshipped in various parts of India and is believed to protect her devotees from evil and bestow them with strength and courage.
